statements: Section 154 of the Transport Act 2000 empowers the Secretary of State, with the approval of the Treasury as respects England, to make grants to operators of eligible bus services towards their costs in operating those services.

Section 154(3) of the Transport Act 2000 allows those grants to be of such amount and subject to such conditions as the Secretary of State determines, which is the mechanism by which a maximum single fare is imposed on participating operators.

Section 113E(5)(a) of the Transport Act 2000 allows an advanced quality partnership scheme to specify requirements as to the maximum fares that may be charged, but that power is held by a local transport authority for the services its scheme covers rather than by the Secretary of State nationally.
The £3 fare cap operates through conditions attached to grant funding rather than through a statutory instrument that fixes fares.
